textbookText: Circle the correct alternative of the following questions.
1. How many times the acceleration due to gravity is increased when the earth is compressed into the size of moon?
i) increased by 20 times ii) increased by 14 times iii) equal to that of moon iv) increased by 2.5 times
2. What is the acceleration of falling feather and coin insides the vacuum?
i) half of the normal value
ii) double of the normal value
iii) half of feather and double of coin
Ans:- iv) both have equal acceleration

4. What is the change in the gravitational force between two objects when their mass is doubled?

Ans:- ii) the force becomes four-time

6. Which one of the following statements is correct?
i) The value of acceleration due to gravity increases as we go deeper from the surface of the earth.
ii) The value of acceleration due to gravity decreases as the height above the surface of the earth increases.
iii) The value of acceleration due to gravity is less in the polar region than that in the equatorial region
iv) The value of the acceleration due to gravity is highest at the highest place on the earth.
Ans:- ii) The value of acceleration due to gravity decreases as the height above the surface of the earth increases.
